# The bake's Python side (tools/bake/osm.py), pinned with the hash of every wheel PyPI lists;
# install with
#   pip install --require-hashes --only-binary=:all: --no-deps -r tools/bake/requirements.txt
# (regenerate with `node scripts/pip-hashes.mjs osmium==…`). --no-deps: pyosmium needs `requests`
# only for replication updates, which the bake never uses. osmium (pyosmium) 4.3.1 was published
# 2026-04-02, the newest release at least two weeks old on 2026-10-12
# (https://pypi.org/project/osmium/#history, checked 2026-10-12).
